name: Lip Sync Studio
intro: Lip Sync Studio in SmartVideo makes a still portrait talk, or re-syncs the mouth in an existing video, to an audio file you upload.

features.portrait-image-mode: Portrait Image is the default mode. Use it when you only have a photo of a person or character and want it to speak your audio.
features.video-mode: Switch to Video mode when you already have footage. It changes the lip movement to match your audio, which suits dubbing or replacing a voice over.
features.model-selector: The model selector is grouped into Portrait Image and Video models. Switching mode picks the first model for you, and models differ in quality, speed and options.
features.resolution-picker: A resolution button appears for models that offer a choice. Higher resolution looks sharper, but it is expected to take longer.
features.optional-prompt: The optional prompt box lets you hint at the talking style or motion. It is only sent to models that accept a prompt.
features.pending-job-recovery-and-history: Every submitted job is remembered. If you reload while one is running, the studio resumes waiting and adds it to History when it is ready.
features.result-actions: When your video is ready, you can start a new one, regenerate, download, publish to social or add AI captions.

outro: Pick a mode, add your media and audio, and Lip Sync Studio gets your characters speaking.
